== frame with_prefix cursor=3,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ TMP_PREFIX=value env | grep TMP_PREFIX
|TMP_PREFIX=value
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 TMP_PREFIX=value
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame without_prefix cursor=5,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ TMP_PREFIX=value env | grep TMP_PREFIX
|TMP_PREFIX=value
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ env | grep TMP_PREFIX
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 TMP_PREFIX=value
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 env
@5 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
